_what: ONE REAL end-to-end SignalDebt lifecycle on this repo's own CI: push -> red -> surfaced -> fixed -> green -> closed. The existence proof for the external-signal watch plane (ADR-058 §D3, DDD-0013 Context 2), which until now had never been shown closing a real loop on real data.
_incident: 2026-07-28, origin/main. .github/workflows/learning-replay.yml carried an UNQUOTED COLON inside a step name. GitHub's workflow parser rejects a bare `: ` inside an unquoted YAML scalar, so the whole file was invalid and every run of that workflow concluded `failure` without executing a step. Two consecutive pushes went red that way. Commit 68b1ce7 quoted the step name; the very next run concluded `success`.
